accumulation_in_round: Three visible builds, all dying with the round: (1) the DEPTH PILLS — three in-flow pills in the top HUD bar (Topsoil / Georgian / King's Hoard) that light up as the spin digs, never floating over the grid (the ding log's exact prescription for persistent badges); (2) the SIGNAL METER on Ron's handheld readout in the same HUD strip — Hot Signal tags surfacing on tiles feed it live, it persists across strata within the spin, and every evaluation multiplies through it; (3) the finds pouch tally. Inside the single Big Dig bonus only, the field, depth, and meter persist across all 10 (+3 retriggered) sweeps — the praised non-resetting-within-the-bonus pattern — then the round pays once and everything resets. Nothing survives past /wallet/end-round.

base_loop_liveness: Rebuilt to the benchmark pacing table. A dead spin (~72% of spins at 1-in-3.6 hit rate) is now: fast sweep burst (~0.7s of flips with single low blips), 0.3s micro-CLUNK on the pipe with a one-frame Ron shrug — total resolve <=1.1s standard, <=0.6s turbo, 380ms autoplay gap. The full geyser gag (~1.8s) plays ONLY when a spin that already dug to Georgian or deeper finally strikes the pipe — a story worth telling, roughly 1 spin in 8, from a rotating pool of 3 splash variants; turbo skips gags entirely. What keeps losers alive: per-symbol progress pips (e.g. 6/8 on the leading symbol) visibly climbing toward the next pay, the Signal Meter ticking up as tags surface, depth pills lighting, and the generator's spectacle floor guaranteeing >=6 reveals per spin so no spin is a two-flip nothing. Anticipation now MEANS something: beep steps 2-3 only precede floods, the scream only precedes Hoard-stratum books.

features: SIGNAL FLOOD — strong-signal tiles flood-open 4-9 adjacent tiles in one chainable burst; flood groups are explicit tile-index lists in the book (deterministic, replay-safe), pure presentation of the underlying tumble book's reveal.

HOT SIGNALS + THE SIGNAL METER — tags (x2-x100, three color-banded chip tiers for 25px legibility) surface on tiles and SUM into one big meter on Ron's readout in the top HUD; the meter applies to every evaluation, persists across strata within the spin, and every win prints its equation line ('12x Chalice 4.0x  x  SIGNAL x27 = 108.0x') so any spot-checked amount is verifiable by eye.

DIG DEEPER — each bagged 8+ win opens the holes into the next stratum (Topsoil > Georgian > King's Hoard, cut from 5 to 3); deeper strata carry richer symbol weights and denser tags; depth pills light within the round only.

THE PIPE — the predetermined stop event, reskinned from the WWII shell: CLUNK on the old water main. Presentation scales with story: topsoil strikes get a 0.3s micro-CLUNK; strikes after reaching Georgian or deeper earn the 1.8s geyser gag; turbo skips gags. The generator guarantees the pipe never strikes before 6 reveals (zero RTP cost).
RON'S DEEP SCAN — random book event: Ron slams his coil and the Signal Meter itself visibly flips to double before the next evaluation — one readable beat, not per-tile bookkeeping.

THE BIG DIG (bonus, 3+ Hoard Chests or buy) — one round of 10 sweeps over ONE persistent field: field, depth, and meter carry across all sweeps; 2 further chests award +3 sweeps (retrigger inside the same round, spelled out in the info tab); pays once at the end — a single book, a single /wallet/play, with /bet/event indexing and Watch-or-Skip resume.
hook: The reels are buried — Big Ron sweeps his detector over a face-down field, every screaming signal flood-opens a patch of finds Minesweeper-style, and each bagged win digs the whole board a stratum deeper until he CLUNKS the old water main.
iteration: One spin = one automatic dig producing multiple evaluations, and under the hood it is a standard scatter-pays TUMBLE book wearing a costume: each stratum is a tumble board state, and the flood-fill reveal order is a presentation pass over it. The field starts face-down; the book's reveal order plays as sweep bursts (single flips plus Signal Floods popping 4-9 book-listed adjacent tiles). Evaluation happens ONLY at flood boundaries, announced by a one-beat SURVEY stamp — never mid-flood — while live per-symbol pips (6/8) show progress toward the next pay, so the 8+ rule teaches itself on-screen. On a pay, finds fly to Ron's pouch and the emptied holes DIG DEEPER: fresh buried tiles slide in one stratum down (Topsoil > Georgian > King's Hoard — three strata, matching three tile-backs) with richer weights and denser tags. Average 2-3 evaluations per winning spin; the tail is reaching the King's Hoard layer. The spin ends when the predetermined Pipe tile is struck (never before 6 reveals) or signals go quiet — the pipe is the book's stop event, exactly like 'no more tumbles.'
mascot: BIG RON — a 60-something solo rogue detectorist: walrus mustache (NO beard), bucket hat (NO flat cap), giant ear-cup headphones, orange hi-vis over a knitted jumper, wellies, tea flask — a silhouette documented as distinct from any BBC-adjacent duo, with no sidekick and no club. FACE: 8 pose sheets plus a 7-part layered rig driven by rAF transforms, giving faints, jigs, headphone-pops, and a tea-spit without Spine. FUNCTION (the honest math-object claim): Ron's handheld readout IS the Signal Meter — the live multiplier every win is multiplied through lives on his device in the HUD; his coil position traces the reveal order; his beep pitch is the anticipation instrument; his Deep Scan slam is the book event that doubles the meter. Delete Ron and the game loses its multiplier display, its reveal source, and its anticipation engine — the win equation literally has nowhere to be read. 'Big Ron's...' remains the franchise spine (Beach Sweep, Bog Dig).

name: SWEEPER
native_verb: SWEEP. A detectorist's sweep IS the reveal pass; graded detector beeps ARE the anticipation choreography (and now they are honest — big beeps only when something big is coming); a strong signal flood-opening a patch IS the burst reveal; DIGGING DEEPER through strata IS the cascade-refill; and clunking the buried water main (the real detectorist heartbreak) IS the diegetic stop event. Every mechanic is something detectorists literally do — zero translation tax.
surface: 6x6 buried-tile field (36 soil plugs), scatter-pays: 8+ matching symbols anywhere among REVEALED tiles pays (Bonanza-familiar count rule), evaluated only at flood boundaries with a SURVEY beat and live per-symbol pips. 9 paying symbols — 4 junk lows with color-and-silhouette-coded reads at 25px (silver ring pull, red bottle cap, long diagonal rusty spoon, U-shaped horseshoe) and 5 finds highs (hammered silver penny, golden buckle, jewelled ring, silver chalice, the King's Crown) — plus Hoard Chest scatter and the Pipe stop-tile. Junk-forward comedy is the symbol identity (the money shot is one crown, not piles of coins). Square grid centers in mobile portrait; at Popout-S 400x225 the depth pills and Signal Meter live in the top HUD as in-flow pills and Ron collapses to a headphones-only micro-dock face — nothing ever over the grid, gated by a week-one screenshot test.
theme: British metal-detectorist hobby comedy, rebuilt after a documented design-diff pass against the obvious BBC touchstone: BIG RON is a SOLO rogue detectorist (no club, no sidekick — the Dave cameo is cut) chasing the legend the show never touched: King John's crown jewels, lost in the Wash in 1216. Golden-hour English farm field, thermos tea, wellies, Ron's homemade painted signs. Zero detectorist slots exist in the 2,007-game SE catalog; it sits in the proven hobby-satire whitespace lane (Duck Hunters energy), and its symbol identity is junk-forward comedy — ring pulls and rusty spoons — not the saturated gold-pile lane. Adult, gently satirical, physical slapstick that travels without dialect. Nothing child-appealing.
volatility_dial: Dial-it-yourself at three altitudes, all pre-commit and all inside the counted 6-table surface: (1) Coil Select in the base game — Standard (lower variance, frequent shallow floods) vs XL Deep Coil (higher variance, RTP weighted into deep strata), equal 96.65% RTP, a pure risk knob like Plinko's row count; (2) Rally ante +25% for 2x bonus frequency, Standard coil only; (3) the 5x / 80x / 400x buy ladder with honest per-tier ceilings (500x / 15,000x / 15,000x). Every knob shows its consequence in plain numbers on the info tab.
why_three_star: It hits the pillars by construction and now survives its own critique. The one twist is intact and genuinely novel — no slot uses Minesweeper flood-fill reveal as its iteration layer — and pre-taught to Stake's own audience (Mines, 25M+ plays/year); the 'Mines reskin' discount is answered head-on: Mines is a decision game about avoiding bombs, SWEEPER is a zero-decision spectacle whose identity is dig-deeper strata plus one summed meter, and its math is the reviewer-trusted scatter-pays tumble chassis with the flood as pure presentation (fallback included). The star gap is won where it is decided — the first 20 spins: dead spins at benchmark pacing (<=1.1s, 380ms autoplay gap), honest graded anticipation, pips always counting toward something, and gags rationed so they still land at spin 200. The mode surface is counted (6 tables), every ceiling honest, the multiplier engine readable in one equation line, the mascot load-bearing as the meter's display, the BBC shadow design-diffed and documented, and both week-one gates (Popout-S screenshot, 100k-book generator) run before a single symbol is painted. Theme originality maximal (0 detectorist games), execution risk systematically retired.
